_about: Combat calculator data. rules = how a turn resolves; skills = what each tree node does in a fight (keyed by node id; grantActive / grantSide give extra actions this turn; perFight limits uses per fight; uses + recharge (short / long) limits uses between rests); weapons = test presets for Dev mode (the Combat page uses the weapons you have equipped); foes = presets for the Combat page. Edit by hand; the app reloads. Fields starting with _ are ignored.

rules.note: Attacks roll a d20. A natural 20 is a critical hit: damage dice are doubled (glossary).
0 = a natural 1 has no effect in combat unless a gem says so (1 Nov). Physical attacks are d20 + AP against the target's DEX score.
Least damage a hit deals after Armour. 0 = Armour can stop a hit completely.
Rage gained when one of your attacks deals damage. Doc: taking damage builds more than dealing it.
Rage gained each time you take damage (Held Wounds damage counts).
Burst of Rage for a kill.
Rage lost on a turn in which you neither deal nor take damage (Barbarian Pathway).
First threshold: Blooded and other threshold nodes switch on.

Endurance check (d20 + Endurance) against this, once per turn, when Rage went past the cap that turn. Fail: lose control next turn and lose Sanity equal to the overflow. Once-per-turn is Claude's proposal; the doc says each gain past the cap.
Endurance check for Unbroken when Rage hits 0.
At the start of a fight everyone rolls this for initiative. Highest acts first; turns go clockwise round the wheel.
1 = initiative is d20 + DEX modifier. Ties: PC before NPC; NPCs reroll until different.
At 0 HP: d20 each turn, this or more is a recover point, less a loss point.
Three loss points: dead. Three recover points: stable but downed until healed to 1 HP.
A fight still going after this many rounds counts as a draw.

fig.secondw1.name: Second Wind
fig.secondw1.text: side action to regain hit points equal to d10 + your level

fig.actions1.name: Action Surge
fig.actions1.text: used as as side action, you can take one additional main action

bbr.headlong1.name: Headlong
bbr.headlong1.text: Charge up to 10 m; builds 1 Rage on impact, 2 if you are struck during the charge.

bbr.headlong2.name: Headlong II
bbr.headlong2.text: Upgrade to Headlong, The charge also deals 1d6 damage on impact.

bbr.unmake1.name: Unmake
bbr.unmake1.text: +1d6 damage per 2 Rage spent. Rage drops to 0.

bbr.unmake2.name: Unmake II
bbr.unmake2.text: Upgrade to Unmake, +2d6 damage per 2 Rage spent.

bbr.blooded2.name: Blooded II
bbr.blooded2.text: Upgrade to Blooded, At 5 Rage or more, melee attacks deal +2d4.

bbr.berserker1.name: Berserker
bbr.berserker1.text: Side action: lower your guard until your next turn. Armour halved; every hit you take builds 1 extra Rage.

bbr.berserker2.name: Berserker II
bbr.berserker2.text: Upgrade to Berserker, Armour halved; 2 extra Rage per hit taken.

bbr.pastred1.name: Past the Red
bbr.pastred1.text: Passive: while Rage is 10 or more, damage dice are doubled. A reward for holding Rage instead of spending it.

bbr.redmist2.name: Red Mist
bbr.redmist2.text: Rage gained above 10 is banked as +1d6 on your next hit, up to 3d6. The surge check still rolls.

bbr.thickit1.name: Thick of It
bbr.thickit1.text: Gain 1 Rage each turn if two or more enemies are within reach.

bbr.bitedown1.name: Bite Down
bbr.bitedown1.text: Spend Rage to recover 1d6 HP per 2 Rage spent as side action

bbr.bitedown2.name: Bite Down II
bbr.bitedown2.text: Upgrade to Bite Down, 2d6 HP per 2 Rage spent.

bbr.grudge1.name: Grudge
bbr.grudge1.text: every time an enemy hits you, you gain 1 extra Rage.

bbr.dti1.name: Draw Them In
bbr.dti1.text: Spend 2 Rage on an Intimidation shout: enemies in reach make a Composure check or must attack you next turn.

bbr.hw1.name: Held Wounds
bbr.hw1.text: While Rage is above 0, hold back up to CON modifier × 2 damage of each hit.

bbr.corpse.name: Corpse-Eater
bbr.corpse.text: Consume a fallen enemy to restore HP and gain Rage. The corpse's foul Quick is fel and enters

bbr.ironmind.name: Iron Mind
bbr.ironmind.text: When a spell targets you, spend 1 Rage to gain advantage on the check against it.

bbr.unbroken.name: Unbroken
bbr.unbroken.text: When Rage hits 0, make an Endurance check. On a success, held damage lands a third per turn over 3 turns instead of at once.

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.note: Placeholder: weapon AP comes from gear once gear exists.

foes.name: Bandit
foes.note: Placeholder numbers until a bestiary exists. defence = the foe's DEX score (physical attacks roll against it); attack = its AP.

foes.name: Training dummy
foes.note: Never hits back. Use it to measure damage per turn.
